description: Declaration of the TTSDownloader class responsible for handling text-to-speech download operations, including thread management and configuration handling.

classes.name: TTSDownloader
classes.description: Provides methods to perform TTS download operations, manage download threads, and handle configuration.

methods.name: TTSDownloader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the downloader with a configuration.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Starts the download process with the given configuration.

methods.name: downloadThread
methods.description: Method invoked in a separate thread to handle downloading.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Attempts to download a file based on the provided TTS request string.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the current configuration to a specified path.
